Name: Seasonal Farmer
Author: BoogaJoker
Description:
[size=5][b]Hey every lover of Stardew Valley![/b][/size]

[size=4]My wife and I got tired of waiting for someone to make the kind of seed and sapling recolor mod we wanted, so we thought: why not try it ourselves?[/size]
[size=4]This is our first mod, and we had never worked with pixel art before, so it was a fun learning project for both of us. We hope people enjoy it, and if anyone wants support for more expansion crops or extra additions, let us know.[/size]
[size=4]This mod recolors seed bags, saplings, tea saplings, and supported expansion items so they better show what season they belong to. The goal is to make farming items easier to recognize at a glance while still keeping a simple Stardew Valley style.
Season colors used by the mod:
🌸 Spring — Pink
🍃 Summer — Green
🍂 Fall — Brownish
❄️ Winter — Blue
Multi-season crops use the colors of the seasons they grow in.
Pink made more sense for Spring because of flowers and not a lot of grass showing, and we didn’t want to copy everyone else, but the rest was logical.[/size]
[heading][size=5]Installation Instructions[/size]
[size=4]Should be installable via Vortex
If added manualy here's the steps:
[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=4]Install the required mods first: SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Download SeasonalFarmer.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Unzip the downloaded file.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Move the SeasonalFarmer folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Launch Stardew Valley and look at the console for any errors if the mod don't work.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Let me know if any expansions support you want so I add it and keep it updated.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]You better have fun or this step don't work.[/size][/*]
[/list][/heading]
[heading][size=5]Main Features[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4]Seed bags based on their growing season.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Fruit saplings based on the season they produce fruit.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Tea container visuals.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Non-seasonal option with default to play with Stardew colours.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Support for selected Stardew Valley Expanded items.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]More support coming, waiting on your feedback.[/size][/*]
[/list][heading][size=5]Requirements[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][size=4]SMAPI[/size][/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][size=4]Content Patcher[/size][/url][/*]
[*][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] (Optional for in-game settings)[/size][/*]
[/list][/heading]
[heading][size=5]Shout Outs[/size][/heading]
[size=4]Big shout out to my wife, who made the assets and helped bring this mod to life. This was our first mod project together, and her work on the pixel art made it possible.[/size]
